notes.h2: 2026-09-29 — จร, ดิน, หู, กาม (45 filed, 6 false-split, 1 spelling-variant)
notes.h3: จร — the Indic -cara, "one who goes"
notes.text:
**Unsure.**
* **นีรจร → 3.** Its etymology on disk reads only นีร + จร, so I filed it. Its
  twins วาริจร and ชลจร are tagged as whole Sanskrit borrowings, and นีรจร is
  almost certainly the same kind of word. If a source says so, it should move
  to false-split.
* **สมจร → 3.** Sexual union read as "going together". It could be 4,
  conduct, the way -cariya is conduct in พรหมจรรย์.
* **จรจัด → 1**, homeless, no fixed place. On จัด's page it files as the
  intensifier (9/26), and the two filings agree.
